values.binNote: The 0.35 AP coefficient appears only inline in the KennenBringTheLight#TotalDamagePassive calculation text (+ 0.35xap); there is no separate named data value for it in the sheet, unlike BaseOnHitDamage and bADRatio which are explicit rows.
The bin has no explicit stack-cap data value for Electrical Surge; the cap of 4 is only stated in the wiki description text.

values.meaning: critical damage on passive empowered attack
values.binNote: TotalDamagePassiveCrit = TotalDamagePassive * 1.4 + 0.4x bonus critDamage; the 140/40 shown here are that same 1.4 base multiplier and 0.4 critDamage coefficient expressed as percentages.

mechanics.claim: Basic attacks generate a stack of Electrical Surge, and at max stacks the next basic attack consumes them to deal bonus magic damage and apply a stack of Mark of the Storm.
mechanics.quote: '''Kennen's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-attack}} generate a stack of ''Electrical Surge'', stacking up to 4 times. At 4 stacks, his next basic attack {{tip|on-attack}} consumes all stacks to both deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and apply a stack of ''{{ai|Mark of the Storm|Kennen}}'' {{tip|on-hit}}

mechanics.claim: The passive bonus damage can critically strike.
mechanics.quote: This damage can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|140|40}}|critical damage}} damage.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack's bonus damage is not applied if Kennen is blinded, though the stacks are still consumed.
mechanics.quote: ''Electrical Surge's'' enhanced attack will be consumed and the bonus damage will not be applied if '''Kennen''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.

mechanics.claim: On-hit effects triggered by the empowered attack's cast instance (e.g. Runaan's Hurricane, Spellblade) will also apply the bonus damage and Mark of the Storm to targets hit.
mechanics.quote: on-hit effects triggered by the enhanced attack's {{tip|cast instance}} (e.g. {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nie|Wind's Fury}}, {{iis|Dusk and Dawn}} {{nie|Spellblade}}) will apply the bonus damage and ''{{ai|Mark of the Storm|Kennen}}'' to targets hit.

mechanics.claim: The active requires a nearby enemy with Mark of the Storm or within Slicing Maelstrom to cast.
mechanics.quote: An enemy within {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 775 units with {{ai|Mark of the Storm|Kennen}} or inside {{ai|Slicing Maelstrom|Kennen}} is required to cast this ability.

mechanics.claim: The active deals magic damage to all nearby enemies afflicted by Mark of the Storm or within Slicing Maelstrom.
mechanics.quote: sends out a surge of electricity that deals {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies afflicted by ''{{ai|Mark of the Storm|Kennen}}'' or within ''{{ai|Slicing Maelstrom|Kennen}}''

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack will trigger but not be consumed nor apply its effects against structures and wards.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attack will trigger but not be consumed nor apply its effects against {{tip|structures}} and {{tip|wards}}.
